headline: RAS阻害剤への耐性は、薬が結ぶ複合体を壊す変異で起こる
subhead: 患者検体の耐性変異を結晶構造と変異体で解析し、Y64変異にも効く化合物を示した
method_label: X-ray・生化学・細胞アッセイ

summary.question: RAS阻害剤ダラキソンラシブへの耐性が、どう生じるかは十分に分かっていなかった。
summary.approach: 患者40人の検体で耐性変異を探し、結晶構造と生化学・細胞の測定で仕組みを調べた。
summary.result: KRAS Y64変異は薬との芳香環の積み重なりを壊し、Y71HはCRAFのRBDとの結合を強めた。
summary.learned: 耐性変異は、薬がRASとCYPAをつなぐ分子糊の働きを壊す点で共通していた。
summary.open: Y71HがCYPA結合にも作用する可能性は、今回のデータでは除外できない。

question.quote: Although these agents have shown clinical activity in RAS mutant cancers, resistance mechanisms remain poorly defined.

approach.quote: Here, we analyzed paired baseline and end-of-treatment samples from 40 patients treated with the RAS inhibitor daraxonrasib and identified recurrent alterations in 18 cases.
we solved the tertiary structure of KRAS Y71H in complex with the RBD of CRAF at a 1.76-Å resolution (Figure 4D; Table S1).

result.quote: The crystal structure of KRAS G12D in complex with the RAS(ON) inhibitor RMC-7977 revealed that Y64 forms a π-π stacking interaction with the indole ring of the inhibitor (Figure 3A).
The structure shows that H71 forms a neomorphic interaction involving both an H-bond and a π-cation interaction with the arginine 67 (R67) residue in the CRAF RBD.

learned.quote: These findings uncover convergent resistance mechanisms that undermine the molecular glue function

open.quote: the data do not exclude the possibility of a dual mechanism where Y71H also modulates CYPA binding (also allosterically)

highlights.text: KRAS Y71HとCRAFのRBDの結晶構造で、H71がRBDのArg67と水素結合とπ-カチオン相互作用を作っていた。この余分な結合でRAFへの親和性が上がり、薬でRAFを追い出しにくくなると考えられる。

evidence.quote: Our structural data suggest that the additional interaction of Y71H is responsible for the higher affinity for the CRAFRBD
The structure shows that H71 forms a neomorphic interaction involving both an H-bond and a π-cation interaction with the arginine 67 (R67) residue in the CRAF RBD.

highlights.text: 別の阻害剤RMC-4791とKRAS・CYPAの複合体では、Y64の積み重なる相手が薬の尾部のピリジン環に変わっていた。この化合物はY64変異体でも効果を保った。

evidence.quote: Moreover, the Y64 residue formed a π-π stacking interaction with the pyridine ring at the tail end of RMC-4791
Together, these data suggest that RMC-4791 is a promising lead to overcome the resistance driven by Y64 mutations

highlights.text: キナーゼ活性のないBRAF変異も耐性を生んだ。RAFが二量体になるとCRDがKRASに結合しやすい向きになり、薬で外れにくくなるらしい。この部分はAlphaFoldのモデルと細胞の実験による。

evidence.quote: The live-cell data argue that RAF dimerization repositions the CRD of RAF in an orientation where it can optimally interact with KRAS, a conformation that is harder to displace by TCIs, thus leading to attenuated inhibition.

lab_notes.expression: KRAS（1–169）とCRAFのRBD（52–131）を大腸菌BL21(DE3)で発現。N末端にHisタグ。
lab_notes.purification: Ni–NTAで精製し、TEVでタグを外してSuperdex 75でゲルろ過した。
lab_notes.sample_prep: シッティングドロップ蒸気拡散法、18 ℃で結晶化。
lab_notes.data_collection: NSLS-IIのFMXビームラインで回折データを収集し、6VJJを探索モデルに分子置換で解いた。

evidence.quote: residues 1–169 of KRAS and residues 52–131 of the RBD were expressed in E. coli BL21(DE3) as N-terminal His-tagged constructs and purified by Ni–NTA affinity chromatography.
The His tag was removed by TEV protease digestion overnight at 4 °C, followed by size-exclusion chromatography on a Superdex 75 column.
Crystallization was carried out by sitting-drop vapor diffusion in 96-well format, mixing 0.5 μL protein solution with 0.5 μL reservoir solution at 18 °C.
Diffraction data were collected at beamline 17-ID-2 (FMX) at NSLS-II, processed with XDS and scaled with AIMLESS.
The structure was solved by molecular replacement with Phaser (Phenix) using the KRAS–CRAF RBD complex (PDB: 6VJJ) as the search model.

editor_notes: collect は『既存構造の利用』に分類したが、本文は自前の結晶構造2つ（KRAS Y71H–CRAF RBD 1.76 Å、KRAS–RMC-4791–CYPA 1.57 Å）を報告している。PDB ID は本文に書かれておらず（Table S1 のみ）、照合できないため新しい構造としては扱わず、注目の構造（8点）として書いた。構造図は既存の KRAS–CRAF RBD 複合体（6VJJ）。
